title: Research: the A1858 contraction does not change the paid frame climbs
body:
## Contribution

`research/a1858-successor-frame-climbs` — a finite negative result for card `scalar-to-moment` (chooser seed `05f92898273de33149bc662a2b87104d`, priority revision 7). **No new κ. The selected record is not edited.**

Suggestion 1, `selected-packing`, is not taken. PR #4170 already transferred the PR #4091 pooled ceiling onto the retained PR #4088 head. This PR takes suggestion 2 and stops where that card says to stop: compare the histograms and report a scalar-only change honestly.

## Established result

On all four frozen words vendored by PR #4152, the published A1858 contraction from PR #3998 leaves every positive-dimension climb of registers 456, 457 and 475 unchanged, and it leaves the recursive frame histogram unchanged.

| Words | Histogram before and after |
|---|---|
| both PR3734 words | `{1:2440,2:725,3:224,4:102,5:20,8:8}` |
| both PR3945 words | `{1:2482,2:712,3:218,4:109,5:20,8:8}` |

Register 457's climb sequence is identical. The only sequence edits are zero-dimension touches: register 456 replaces A indices 1859 and 1860 by 1858, and register 475 replaces A indices 1858 and 1860 by 1859. Widening the block frame fails containment. Deleting the block changes the histogram. A flipped sign fails the three-register map.

PR #3998 already stated the PR3734 profile. This note does not replay that package. It answers the climb question PR #4152 left open. No predecessor Python is imported.

## Limits

No paid transition is removed. Native, owner, precision, stock and the PR3945 producer bill are not priced. `make frontier4470-verify` was not run; this checkout cannot execute the selected baseline. Replay passed on Python 3.12: `PASS_A1858_SUCCESSOR_FRAME_CLIMBS` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
